title: Introduction to Abstract Data Types (ADT)
overview: A focused revision guide to introduction to abstract data types (adt).

sections.title: Stacks (LIFO)
content: Add/remove only from the top — push() to add, pop() to remove. Used for undo functions and managing recursive calls.

sections.title: Queues (FIFO)
content: Add at the rear (enqueue), remove from the front (dequeue). A circular queue reuses freed space at the front rather than shifting all elements.

sections.title: Linked lists
content: Each node stores data plus a pointer to the next node — insertion/deletion just changes pointers, no shifting like an array.

examTips: Pseudocode for push/pop or enqueue/dequeue should always include an overflow/underflow check — frequently a separate mark.
